Hi Alice / Marissa —

Correct — Finly policy blocks guest access to Meet events when the event organizer is external. We require either:

1) The event organizer be a @finly.com user (we can accept an organizer change if the event is recreated by a Finly host), or
2) Use Zoom for external-facing invites (Zoom join URL is allowed with our SSO).

If you'd like, we can accept a calendar event with a Zoom URL and will allow guest join buttons for invitees. Otherwise, set the organizer to one of our team’s accounts (I can take that on, but we prefer meetings to come with a Zoom link).

We include a short policy doc for reference.

Regards,
